term.label: Fall 2025
term.note: Frozen copies of the notebooks as they were taught in Fall 2025. The live notebooks on the course home page are being revised topic by topic; these ones never change, so links given out during Fall 2025 keep working and students can still practise on the version they sat the exams on.

exams.title: Midterm Examination
exams.blurb: Objective questions, code tracing, debugging, and two paper-based reasoning problems — variables and arithmetic through control flow, functions, lists and tuples, comprehensions, lambda and filter.
exams.keywords: midterm mid term code tracing debugging conceptual reasoning lists tuples functions loops lambda filter

exams.title: Final Term Examination
exams.blurb: Thirty MCQs, sixty one-mark output questions across dictionaries, sets, NumPy, pandas, strings and file handling, then a climate-trend script to read and explain block by block.
exams.keywords: final term end semester numpy pandas dictionaries sets strings files exceptions linear regression sklearn climate trend linregress
